common_base.review_task: Start from the downstream result, inspect the downstream pipeline, trace the exact handoffs upstream, assess all six declared boundaries across both jobs, and return one top root-cause boundary in either job or no suspect.

expected_outputs: coverage DataFrame with record_id, need, capability_id, coverage
semantic_declarations.role: Map allowed handoff needs to direct capability coverage while tolerating missing capability fields.

expected_outputs: priorities DataFrame with unsupported status and upstream rank
semantic_declarations.role: Rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream provenance rank as the primary ordering key within each group.

expected_outputs: recommendation dictionary with top_need and decision
semantic_declarations.role: Retain eight ranked priorities and construct the recommendation directly from the first ranked record.

expected_inputs: corpus DataFrame with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, source_weight
expected_outputs: DataFrame of selected demand records constructed from Python dictionary literals
semantic_declarations.role: Select demand records using the score threshold while keeping the explicit fallback identifiers in the returned data path.

expected_outputs: bounded normalized needs DataFrame preserving allowed corpus identifiers
semantic_declarations.role: Normalize selected evidence to required columns, neutral sentinels, allowed identifiers, and bounded index window.

expected_outputs: evidence_sources DataFrame with record_id, source_id, source_weight, rank
semantic_declarations.role: Assemble ranked source provenance with missing-safe field access and deterministic ordering.
